name: Part-based MHE-augmented NeRF
aliases: Learning Neural Volumetric Representations of Dynamic Humans in Minutes
definition: Decomposes the human body into multiple anatomical parts, assigning each part its own MHE-augmented NeRF network to efficiently distribute representational power and accelerate training.
summary: Part-based MHE-augmented NeRF rapidly reconstructs dynamic human videos by assigning each anatomical part a tailored Multiresolution Hash Encoding network to balance speed and fidelity.
